title: Quintessential Gooey Middle Eastern Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew featuring fermented lentils, pancetta, and Middle Eastern spices, perfect for a sick day. This vegetarian-friendly dish is made with ferment-jang for added depth of flavor.
instructions: In a large pot, cook the diced pancetta over medium heat until crispy, then set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, and ferment-jang, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, vegetable broth, and tomato paste to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the stew to desired consistency, or leave chunky.
Stir in the cooked pancetta and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
